coff-westmoreland.st: A 1906 Detroit News wreck-cargo feature, reprinted in the Bay City Tribune, puts her sinking near Manitou Island about 1854 and says the whisky was never recovered; it says nothing of gold.
src: Detroit News, 16 Sep 1906, p. 55 (Newspapers.com 1378026443); reprinted Bay City Tribune, 23 Dec 1906, p. 24 (1182867089)

tw-mi-bellevue-dolph-stumps.st: The Battle Creek Enquirer adds that the strangers said they were looking for 'Black Jack'.
src: Detroit Evening Times, 5 Feb 1914, p. 11 (Newspapers.com 814253000; earlier wire, unread)
